Final Answer: 0.0562

To calculate the annual return, we use the formula:

$$
\text{Annual Return} = \frac{\text{Ending Price} - \text{Beginning Price}}{\text{Beginning Price}}
$$

Plugging in the given values:

$$
\text{Annual Return} = \frac{138.47 - 131.10}{131.10} = \frac{7.37}{131.10} \approx 0.0562
$$

Next, the Sharpe Ratio is calculated as:

$$
\text{Sharpe Ratio} = \frac{\text{Annual Return} - \text{Risk-Free Rate}}{\text{Annualized Standard Deviation}}
$$

Using the given risk-free rate of 1.62% (0.0162) and annualized standard deviation of 21.93
